text: DSH Auto Work Details 是一个面向 DSH Web 的界面插件，会在对话中自动展开正在运行的工作详情组，并在该段工作结束后折叠它。插件把观察器放在当前会话的对话区域，只响应运行状态变化，通过原生标题按钮切换详情组；运行期间用户仍可自行切换。它适合希望自动查看 agent 当前工作进度、并在完成后收起详情的用户。插件不需要额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

DSH Auto Work Details is a DSH Web plugin that expands a work-detail group while its segment runs and folds it when it finishes. It observes the current conversation and uses the group's native header button. Users can still toggle the group during a run. No API key or external service is required.
想让 DSH 自动展开 agent 正在处理的工作详情。
Can DSH open the work details while a task is running and fold them when it finishes?
DSH Auto Work Details 的功能「自动展开并收起工作详情」：对话中的工作组开始运行时自动展开，运行结束后自动折叠。插件观察当前会话的工作组状态，并通过标题按钮切换显示。

@local/dsh-auto-work-details README · DSH Auto Work Details：A small browser-side DSH plugin that expands a running work-detail group at the standard height and folds that group when its segment finishes.
@local/dsh-auto-work-details README · Compatibility：Verified: DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 (source review and automated checks); Desktop testing has not been completed.

@local/dsh-auto-work-details README · Behaviour：- Always on while the bundle is enabled; the plugin has no Settings entry.
- Each composer observes only its own Conversation, including an embedded child chat. Switching its session or unmounting it disposes that observer.
- While a process group is running (`[data-shimmer]` is present on its header), a collapsed group is opened once through the native header click. That path uses Chat's own `initialize('bottom')` and follow logic, so the standard height cap and bottom-following are preserved.
- When the group stops running, the group is closed once through the same native control.
- Manual toggles during the same running segment are not fought: the observer reacts only to the transition into and out of the running phase.
- The synthetic click suppresses the header's `focus()` call, so opening a group does not steal the caret from the composer.

@local/dsh-auto-work-details README · Behaviour：Earlier versions exposed a switch that stored `dsh-auto-work-details.enabled` in `localStorage`; the plugin now removes that leftover key when it loads.

@local/dsh-auto-work-details README · Limits：- It depends on Conversation's `[data-conversation-content]` / `[data-conversation-session]` scope and Chat's `[data-step-process]`, `[data-chat-group-key]`, `[data-shimmer]`, and `aria-expanded` markers. An unresolved or mismatched Conversation is left alone.
- It only works in modes that render a process-group header (Standard and Compact); Detailed and Verbose have no running group header to toggle.
- An auto-close is skipped when Chat's focus protection decides the group must stay visible, or when a whole-Turn fold is already animating that group.
- A future Chat update can change these markers without notice.

@local/dsh-auto-work-details README · Install：Clone this fork (`iBobbyTS/dsh-auto-work-details`) and install its checkout as a DSH bundle. Replace the path and choose the profile you actually use:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-auto-work-details
```

For Desktop, use its bundled CLI with `--profile desktop`, after launching Desktop once and quitting it. Restart the target Host and refresh its client after installing.

@local/dsh-auto-work-details README · Install：`dsh plugin ... add` links the package and also records `@local/dsh-auto-work-details` in the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`; installing through the Plugin Manager performs the same steps.
